title: 第18幕疯狂的4杀ultra-kill第19幕现实中的天神游戏
content_zh:
闪耀星尘作品 时间掌控者的刀塔 时间掌控者的刀塔 第一卷 独一无二的新人 第18幕 疯狂的4杀Ultra－kill
“各位，现在我们拿下1个人头了！”
听到邢辰的话，已经被杀怕了的风行者就是一哆嗦，见势不妙立刻开启保命技能就要逃跑，却不想邢辰刚刚在树林里开出的那条狭窄通道恰好被想要上前支援的撼地神牛堵住，两人一个想逃一个想上迎头撞在了一起，结果两个人都卡得半天动不了。
“给老子让开啊傻x！堵什么路！？”
“艹啊！老子堵路！？咱们4个对面就俩，你跑个球啊！”
“4个！？只剩下3个了行不行！？再不跑还有命么！？”
暗痕听不到风行者和撼地神牛在队伍频道里面的互喷，但是看到有机可乘自然也不会放过，立刻控制着幻影刺客闪烁到撼地神牛的背后疯狂砍杀起来，短短两三秒的功夫，撼地神牛就被拥有狂战斧的幻影刺客打出暴击，5刀秒杀。
“暗痕已经无人能挡！”
震撼人心的电子音刚落，邢辰冰冷的声音又响起在了公共频道：
“各位，两个人头了！现在是几对几呢？”
随即，幻影刺客给风行者上了一记窒息之刃，4秒内减速50%的效果让他无处可逃！风行者脆弱的身板一旦没了风行者这个技能的物理攻击100%躲避的效果，很快也倒在了末日使者和幻影刺客的围攻之下。
“暗痕已经变态杀戮！”
“3个人头，老太婆可就你一个了啊！”
最后，邢辰和暗痕的目标自然转向了正一脸郁闷无法使用物品栏无法释放技能的宙斯。
“开……开什么玩笑！？为什么会这样！？4打2居然会打不过！”
蓝蝶惊恐的喃喃着，想要让脚下的步伐更快一些好逃离那两个魔鬼，却怎奈游戏数据就是那样，就算再怎么着急宙斯的那一双小短腿也快不起来。
刚才见势不妙的蓝蝶早就撒腿跑路了，只可惜那三个队员并没能替她争取到太多的时间，很快便被开着焦土加速的末日使者追上，4级死亡幸运数字是3，而此时的宙斯正好12级，触发幸运数字之下瞬间遭到了275点外加最大生命值20%的超高伤害。重伤的宙斯随后被使用幻影突袭飞到身旁的幻影刺客随便砍了两下收到人头。
“ultra－kill！”
“m－m－m－m－m－m－m－m……monster－kill！”
“暗痕已经妖怪般的杀戮！”

“4个人头全部收下，现在，请问谁是猎人谁是猎物？！”
公共频道之中再次响起了邢辰的声音，回应他的则是死一般的沉默。
从刚刚的4人团抓到现在被两人杀翻，暗痕的幻影刺客更是迎来了妖怪般的杀戮！对面的人已经被杀得丧了胆！
正在死亡读秒、眼前一片死灰的蓝蝶老太婆不可思议的张大着嘴巴，始终无法置信刚刚发生的一切。她不明白为什么邢辰在那种状态下还敢反打，更不能理解为什么他们4打2居然还能够被打得团灭！
“明明知道幻影刺客没有称属性根本撑不下我们一轮技能，自己也没有1挑4的能力，却还能够一瞬间做出最正确的判断，抓住我们技能处在cd状态的时机反打，一个人废掉了我的宙斯和撼地神牛两个爆发了最足的英雄，最后2打4团灭我们……说这个末日使者是新人，这也太tm新了！根本就是扮猪吃虎啊！”
在心里哀叹一通之后蓝蝶又看了看仍然在下路线上独自打钱的敌法师身上的装备，她知道这次自己恐怕只能拿到50金币了。
“1300分……真是个笑话……”
…………
安安稳稳收下四个助攻，邢辰正准备回泉水恢复恢复顺便把金钱换成装备，暗痕却是先找了上来，兴奋的盯着他叫道：
“你小子真行啊！这种情况下居然还真敢上！居然还就给你打赢了！”
邢辰无所谓的一笑：“如果他们不是菜鸟我早跑了，不过就他们的水平，来多少也不用怕！”
暗痕点了点头：“对头！现在收下这笔钱之后是真的什么也不用怕了！哈哈！”
“那就快点结束吧，时间拖久了又要死人了。”
“没看出来你这小子的心肠还挺软了。行，再给我五分钟就差不多了，到时候一波打掉他们基地！”
回到泉水之后，拿到4个助攻的末日使者已经做好了隐刀——洛萨之锋，在泉水恢复了一下状态之后直接传送到下路准备去找敌法师的麻烦。
丝毫没有意识到危险的敌法师仍然在野店附近补着刀，末日使者靠近之后立刻狠狠砍向敌法师，敌法师头顶上立刻飘起一个150的破隐一击伤害，接着死亡和大招末日两个技能也被邢辰给丢了出来。
狂战刷钱流的敌法师实在太脆了，全身一点属性没有撑，等到末日使者第二次死亡放出之后直接收走了敌法师的人头。
邢辰无聊的摇了摇头，只觉得这种虐菜实在没什么成就感。
22分钟时，暗痕的幻影刺客已经做出了假腿、狂战斧和黑黄杖，而邢辰则又多了一件弗拉迪米尔的祭品为团队提供各种光环效果。
而此时的敌法师则只有假腿和弗拉迪米尔的祭品，狂战斧仍然遥遥无期。

暗痕认为自己的这一身装备已经差不多了，便集结了队伍浩浩荡荡的向着天灾的中路二塔开拔。
然而，邢辰他们战意满满的这次总共却因为对方的内讧而打在了棉花上。
作为替补的遗忘法师和风行者希望战斗到最后一刻多争取些分数成为英魂存活下来，而即便输了也还有成为替补机会的敌法师和撼地神牛则完全没有任何战意只求快点结束，否则再拖个一两分钟下次审判死得就铁定是他们俩之中的一个了！
塔下，暗影萨满插下的蛇棒拉开了进攻的序幕，开启黑黄杖拥有了魔法免疫体质的幻影刺客一马当先冲入敌阵，遗忘法师和风行者无人能撑过3秒，纷纷倒在了幻影刺客的环形战刃之下。
当以一个4倍暴击结果了蓝蝶的宙斯之后，邢辰他们顺势攻破了近卫的中路高地，然后开始转攻其他两路的中塔。
从头到尾敌法师和撼地神牛都没有出现，战斗已经失去了意义！
随着近卫的生命古树轰然倒塌，邢辰他们轻松的赢下了这场事关生死的试炼之战。
原本邢辰还打算在战斗之后和暗痕好好聊聊了解一下天神游戏的状况，可是没想到战斗刚刚结束他便眼前一黑，消失不见了。
“走这么急？还想跟这扮猪吃虎的小子聊上两句呢，算了算了……”
站在邢辰旁边同样打算上去聊两句的暗痕只能摇了摇头，乐呵呵的查收了自己的任务奖励之后传送出了对战地图。
content_en:
Shining Stardust Works The Time Master's Knife Tower The Time Master's Knife Tower Volume 1 Unique Newcomer Act 18 Crazy 4-Kill Ultra-kill
"Everyone, now we have taken 1 head!"
Hearing Xing Chen's words, Windrunner, who was already afraid of being killed, trembled. Seeing that the situation was not good, he immediately activated his life-saving skills and was about to run away. However, the narrow passage that Xing Chen had just opened in the woods was blocked by the earth-shaking sacred cow who wanted to come forward for support. One of them wanted to escape, and the other wanted to come forward, but they collided head-on. As a result, both of them were stuck unable to move for a long time.
"Get out of my way, you idiot! Why are you blocking the road!?"
"What the hell! I'm blocking the road!? There are only two of us facing each other, you run the ball!"
"Four!? There are only 3 left, okay!? If you don't run away, will you still be alive!?"
Darkhen couldn't hear the exchange of words between Windrunner and Earth-shaking Divine Bull in the team channel, but when he saw an opportunity, he would not let it go. He immediately controlled the phantom assassin to flash behind the Earth-shaking Divine Bull and started slashing wildly. In just two or three seconds, the Earth-shaking Divine Bull was critically hit by the phantom assassin with a mad battle ax, killing him with 5 swords.
"Dark Mark is unstoppable!"
As soon as the shocking electronic sound ended, Xing Chen's cold voice sounded on the public channel again:
"Everyone, there are two heads! How many are we now?"
Immediately, the Phantom Assassin gave Windrunner a suffocating blade, which slowed him down by 50% within 4 seconds, leaving him with nowhere to escape! Once Windrunner's fragile body lost the 100% evasion effect of the physical attack of Windrunner's skill, he soon fell under the siege of the Doomsday Messenger and Phantom Assassin.
"Dark Mark has gone crazy and killed!"
"There are three heads, but you are the only old woman!"
In the end, Xing Chen and An Hen's target naturally turned to Zeus, who was looking depressed and unable to use the inventory and release skills.
"Are you...are you kidding!? Why is this happening!? You can't beat 4 on 2!"
Landie murmured in horror, wanting to move faster to escape from the two devils, but the game data was like that. No matter how anxious Zeus was, his short legs couldn't move faster.
Lan Die, who had just seen that the situation was not good, had already run away. Unfortunately, the three team members could not buy her much time. She was soon caught up by the Doomsday Messenger who was driving the scorched earth acceleration. The lucky number for death at level 4 was 3, and Zeus was at level 12 at this time. When the lucky number was triggered, he instantly suffered a super high damage of 275 points plus 20% of his maximum health. The seriously injured Zeus was then casually chopped twice by the Phantom Assassin who flew to him using Phantom Strike and was beheaded.
"Ultra-kill!"
"m-m-m-m-m-m-m-m...monster-kill!"
"Dark Mark has been killing like a monster!"
"I have collected all 4 heads. Now, who is the hunter and who is the prey?!"
Xing Chen's voice sounded again in the public channel, and he was answered with deathly silence.
From being captured by a group of four to being killed by two people, Dark Mark's Phantom Assassin has been experiencing monster-like killings! The people on the opposite side have been killed so much that they are terrified!
The old woman Lan Die, who was counting down her death, with her eyes filled with death, opened her mouth in disbelief, still unable to believe what had just happened. She didn't understand why Xing Chen dared to fight back in that state, let alone why they were able to be defeated in a 4-on-2 fight!
"Knowing clearly that the Phantom Assassin has no attributes and can't sustain one round of our skills, and he doesn't have the ability to fight 1 vs 4, but he is still able to make the most correct judgment in an instant and seize the opportunity to counterattack when our skills are in the CD state. One person destroyed my Zeus and Earth-shaking Bull, two heroes who had the strongest burst, and in the end, 2 vs 4 groups destroyed us... This is the end of the story.The Japanese messenger is a newcomer, this is too new! It’s basically pretending to be a pig and eating the tiger! "
After lamenting in her heart, Landie looked at the equipment on the anti-mage who was still farming alone on the lower route. She knew that she might only be able to get 50 gold coins this time.
"1300 points... what a joke..."
…………
An An received four assists steadily, and Xing Chen was about to return to the spring to recover and exchange money for equipment, but An Hen came up to him first, stared at him excitedly and shouted:
“You’re so good, kid! Under such circumstances, he actually dared to do it! I actually won the battle for you! "
Xing Chen smiled indifferently: "If they weren't rookies, I would have run away, but at their level, there is no need to be afraid no matter how much they come! "
An Hen nodded: "The enemy! Now that I have accepted this money, I really don’t have to worry about anything! Ha ha! "
"Then let's end it quickly. If time goes on, people will die again. "
“I didn’t realize that you kid is quite soft-hearted. Okay, just give me another five minutes and that’s it. Then we’ll knock out their base in one wave! "
After returning to the spring, the Doombringer, who had received 4 assists, had already prepared the hidden knife - Lothar's Edge. After the spring recovered for a while, he teleported directly to the bottom lane to prepare for trouble with the anti-mage.
The anti-mage, who was not aware of the danger at all, was still recuperating his sword near the wild shop. After the messenger of doom approached, he immediately slashed hard at the anti-mage. A 150 damage breaking hit appeared above the head of the anti-mage, and then Xing Chen also threw out the two skills of death and ultimate doom.
The anti-mage who was fighting for money was too fragile, and his whole body had no attributes. When the Doombringer died for the second time and was released, he directly took away the head of the anti-mage.
Xing Chen shook his head boredly, feeling that there was really no sense of accomplishment in this kind of abuse.
At 22 minutes, Dark Mark's Phantom Assassin had already made a prosthetic leg, a wild battle axe, and a black and yellow staff, while Xing Chen added another Vladimir sacrifice to provide the team with various halo effects.
At this time, the Anti-Mage only had prosthetic legs and Vladimir's sacrifice, and the Battle Fury Ax was still far away.
Darkhen thought that his equipment was almost enough, so he gathered his team and headed towards the second tower in the middle of the natural disaster.
However, Xing Chen and the others, who were full of fighting spirit, were defeated because of the other party's internal strife.
As substitutes, the Forgotten Mage and Windrunner hope to fight until the last moment to gain more points and survive as heroic souls. However, even if they lose, they still have a chance to become substitutes. The Anti-Mage and the Earth-Shaking Divine Ox have no intention of fighting at all and just want it to end quickly. Otherwise, if it is delayed for another minute or two, one of them will definitely die in the next trial!
Under the tower, the snake rod inserted by the shadow shaman kicked off the attack. The phantom assassin, who had activated the black and yellow rod and possessed magic immunity, rushed into the enemy's formation first. Neither the Forgotten Mage nor the Windrunner could survive 3 seconds, and they all fell under the ring blade of the phantom assassin.
After defeating Blue Butterfly's Zeus with a 4x critical hit, Xing Chen and the others took advantage of the situation to attack the guards' middle high ground, and then began to attack the other two middle towers.
From the beginning to the end, the enemy mage and the earth-shaking sacred bull did not appear, and the battle had lost its meaning!
As the ancient tree of life of the guards collapsed, Xing Chen and the others easily won this life-and-death trial battle.
Originally, Xing Chen planned to have a chat with Anhen after the battle to understand the situation of Tianshen Games, but he didn't expect that just after the battle, his vision went dark and he disappeared.
"Going in such a hurry? I still want to chat with this guy who pretends to be a pig and eats the tiger, forget it..."
An Hen, who was standing next to Xing Chen and also wanted to chat, could only shake his head. He happily checked his mission rewards and then sent out the battle map.
